title: Guess What GTA 6 Made in ONE Day 💰 #shorts
description:
Guess before the end: how much did GTA 6 make by the end of day one? Comment a number.

GTA 5 made about $800 million on its first day in 2013. GTA 6 launched on 19 Nov 2026: Rockstar/Take-Two say 32.5 million copies were sold before launch and $3.79 billion in worldwide retail sales by the end of day one (company estimate, pre-orders included; that's what players paid, not what the company keeps).

Sources: Take-Two/Rockstar figures via Fortune (25 Nov 2026), VideoGamer (23 Nov 2026), Endgame Tools (Take-Two 2013 8-K for GTA 5)
